title: 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with 850nm thickness cap and peak re-initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining individual layer thicknesses to 850nm maximum will reduce optical path difference accumulation and stabilize interference conditions, while re-initializing from the iteration_11 peak candidate (score 0.2961) will escape the degraded optimization basin observed in iteration_13.
design_principle: Quarter-wave-based dichroic stack with bounded thickness optimization; thickness cap prevents excessive OPD that destabilizes the LWIR passband while maintaining MWIR suppression through constructive interference in the reflection band.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (12 finite layers, alternating sequence starting with ZnS)
design_variables: Optimizer learning rate (reduced by 40% from baseline)
soft_objectives: Maintain valid candidate count above zero
manufacturing_considerations: Individual layer thickness capped at 850nm for deposition uniformity
ZnS and ZnSe both compatible with thermal evaporation per evidence
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack dichroic design principle for broadband reflection/transmission control
Stress-matched multilayer preparation for ZnS compressive stress regime
expected_advantages: Thickness cap stabilizes interference conditions by limiting OPD accumulation
Re-initialization from peak candidate provides better starting point than random or quarter-wave initialization
Reduced learning rate prevents optimizer overshoot in early iterations
known_risks: Thickness cap may limit achievable spectral contrast if thicker layers are physically necessary
Re-initialization may still converge to same local optimum if basin attraction is strong
12-layer topology already tested in multiple prior iterations with excluded fingerprints
execution_request_english: Perform coherent TMM optimization for a 12-layer planar dielectric stack on Ge substrate with air incidence at normal angle. Layer sequence: ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe (12 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses from vector [417, 455, 500, 696, 850, 850, 553, 510, 593, 501, 417, 455] nm (peak candidate from iteration_11 with 1000nm layers capped to 850nm). Bound all thicknesses to 100-850nm range. Optimize for high transmittance in 8000-11000nm band and low transmittance in 3000-5000nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with learning rate step multiplier reduced by 40% from default. Wavelength sweep: 3000-11000nm with dense sampling in both target bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directives: 850nm thickness cap to restrict OPD accumulation, re-initialization from iteration_11 peak candidate (score 0.2961), and 40% learning rate reduction to dampen overshoot. Addresses the score regression from 0.2961 to 0.1679 observed between iteration_11 and iteration_13.
